lanes.summary: The diff fully satisfies the requirements of PMAT-1365 by declaring `make gate` and backing it with `scripts/gate.sh`. The gate correctly evaluates required status contexts and prevents execution of stale binaries by dynamically substituting `$PMAT_BIN` at runtime. Control scripts and unit tests are properly implemented. Furthermore, the previously rejected PMAT-1386 lifecycle row has been successfully reverted and is absent from the diff, confirming that this PR adheres to the scope constraints. No refuting evidence or gate weakening was found.

findings.claim: `Makefile` declares a `.PHONY gate` target executing `@bash scripts/gate.sh`, which prevents discovery fallback to `cargo test --workspace`.

`scripts/gate.sh` resolves `$PMAT_BIN` from `cargo build --message-format json` and rewrites step `./target/debug/pmat` paths dynamically at runtime, preventing stale binary execution under `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`.
`docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml` updates PMAT-1365 with the `kind:code` label. The previously rejected PMAT-1386 row has been successfully reverted and is no longer present in the diff.
`contracts/make-gate-v1.yaml` formally specifies the properties and proof obligations for `make gate`.

lanes.summary: The diff fully satisfies ticket PMAT-1365 without weakening any gate or violating repository invariants. It implements `make gate` backed by `scripts/gate.sh`, dynamically runs CI workflow steps directly from GitHub Actions definitions, reports all unmeasured CI-only rows on both green and red exits, resolves `$PMAT_BIN` dynamically to avoid stale binary reuse under `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`, validates falsification behavior across 12 arms in `scripts/gate-control.sh` (measured: exit 0), validates contract obligations with pv (measured: 0 errors, 0 warnings), and passes all 6 unit tests in `src/make_gate_tests.rs` (measured: ok 6/6). No foreign roadmap rows are added (PMAT-1386 was landed upstream on master). Both reachability and unrun-tests ledgers are current. No refuting evidence was found.

findings.claim: Makefile declares a .PHONY `gate` target executing `@bash scripts/gate.sh`, establishing the declared quality gate and preventing discovery fallback to `cargo test --workspace`.

`scripts/gate.sh` maps and accounts for all 6 required CI status contexts (`gate`, `ci / gate`, `docs build (docs.rs environment)`, `feature-gate`, `pmat score`, `provable ladder`), refusing unaccounted contexts, reasonless CI-only rows, or vacuous tables with exit code 2.

`scripts/gate.sh` resolves `$PMAT_BIN` dynamically from `cargo build --message-format json` and rewrites `./target/debug/pmat` in workflow step text at run time, ensuring all pmat legs run the freshly built binary under any `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`.

`scripts/gate-control.sh` executes 12 falsification arms asserting failure behavior on missing contexts, deleted/altered workflow steps, GitHub Actions syntax dependencies, vacuous tables, and stale binaries. Measured: exits 0 with all 12 arms verified.

`cargo test --lib make_gate_tests` passes all 6 unit tests independently validating the Makefile target declaration, workflow step parsing, context coverage, disallowance of invalid CI-only exemptions, and prohibition of hand-written binary paths. Measured: 6 passed, 0 failed.
`contracts/make-gate-v1.yaml` formally specifies the properties and proof obligations for `make gate`. Measured: `pv validate contracts/make-gate-v1.yaml` reported 0 errors and 0 warnings.
`docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml` updates PMAT-1365 with label `kind:code` and carries no unrelated foreign lifecycle rows (PMAT-1386 was merged upstream on master in #1387).
